project.name: Episteme — machine-oriented generator language
project.summary: Progress the 19 preserved input obligations with executable generator contracts, browser evidence, qualified source intake, and honest capability limits.
project.description:
Episteme is the existing data-oriented generator language recorded by the 19 authoritative input strings in src/session.js. This project tracks concrete remaining obligations: executed website interactions; bounded executable mathematics; the distinction between executable primitives and STEM/NLP phrase fragments; and qualified source/provenance preservation.

Evidence rules: preserve all 19 inputs and their order; attach tested source/harness identity; retain failed candidates and unresolved requirements; keep headless operation independent of the interface. Finite checks support only their stated contracts. Human-level intellect or autonomous breeder competence is not a completion criterion without a separately specified, authorized evaluation design.

FKDB source recovery is grounded at redogit/Other-Projects- commit 4a05785e4376c558ed7ad761f89db9dd241bca7b. It offers bounded native browsing and provenance/artifact mechanisms; its native path does not execute Episteme JavaScript/CSS/forms. Supabase list_projects currently returns an empty projects array, so no target database or provisioning is assumed.

Prepared evidence: docs/progression/fkdb-and-supports.md and evidence/progression/supports-read-evidence.json. Current progress: all seven actual Chromium test bodies executed successfully in the strict 17-case interface run. A two-term repair preserves destination effective confidence and maximum-length requirements during fragment insertion. Mathematical proof, independent computation, and the final aggregate are recorded in the accompanying progression evidence. Task-specific evidence is named in each issue.

Verified progression, 2026-10-06: final project gate 148/148 (zero failures/skips), strict interface 17/17 including seven actual Chromium bodies, internal suites 155/155, and three headless scenarios. <issue id="9469e591-7f27-47ac-8fcc-dfc86aef36ce" href="https://linear.app/fighting-decay-of-knowlege/issue/FIG-18/execute-the-episteme-website-interaction-gate-in-a-real-browser">FIG-18</issue> and <issue id="eff86ff1-6c69-4f50-9b49-c3d356015484" href="https://linear.app/fighting-decay-of-knowlege/issue/FIG-19/verify-obligation-conjunction-and-preserve-destination-defaults-during">FIG-19</issue> record completed browser and bounded composition work. <issue id="3b582ef9-eb09-47a8-b20f-10df1f133594" href="https://linear.app/fighting-decay-of-knowlege/issue/FIG-20/admit-one-bounded-executable-stemnlp-primitive-with-a-versioned">FIG-20</issue> and <issue id="d8a93ac3-5f52-45f8-a493-32d3756ecf6e" href="https://linear.app/fighting-decay-of-knowlege/issue/FIG-21/keep-bounded-source-intake-and-fkdb-artifact-provenance-auditable">FIG-21</issue> retain production primitive admission and provenance work as open. All 19 original session strings and 18 catalog declarations are preserved. Full report: docs/progression/report.md in the updated combined Episteme package.
